author: Nintendo of America
description:
Pre-order and play the free demo for FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6006aZv60 

Take a first look at content and features included in the first HD 2D FINAL FANTASY! 

The pixel-art world of FINAL FANTASY returns in this reimagined adventure! The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon. Try out the first chapter in the free demo! 

#FINALFANTASY #RESONANCE

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The free Season of Scares update is live in Disney Dreamlight Valley! Play today on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6000aJGLQ 

Oogie Boogie takes over the Valley, bringing with him six weeks of thrilling Halloween challenges and frightfully delightful rewards! 

Something strange is happening inside Scrooge's Store... Will you risk trick-or-treating while Oogie Boogie is in charge? Don't miss your chance to unlock another Villager from Halloween Town, along with Zero, Jack Skellington's ghostly companion.
